name: ExchangeRequirements
title: Requirements for Exchanging Health Data The Right Way
publisher: The Committee for Doing It Properly
description: The normative requirements of this guide. Each is a SHALL; several have footnotes.

statement.label: Use the standard
statement.requirement:
Systems SHALL exchange data using the standard.

*Footnote: 'the standard' means the version of the standard current at the time of contract signature, not this one.*

statement.label: Validate
statement.requirement:
Systems SHALL validate every resource they receive against the profiles in this guide.

*Footnote: where validation is too slow, systems SHALL feel bad about it.*

statement.label: Record the excuse
statement.requirement: Where a system does not meet REQ-1 or REQ-2, it SHALL record the reason using the [Excuse extension](StructureDefinition-ext-excuse.html).

statement.label: Terminology
statement.requirement: Systems SHOULD use the bound value sets. Systems that use a local spreadsheet instead SHOULD at least keep the spreadsheet up to date.
